Lemma
[Two-point reduced-distance estimate] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0128, page-0129, page-0130, page-0131, page-0132 ↗ def:chow-iii-reduced-distance 1. ch19:19.46\group Reduced Geometry

For a $\kappa $-solution and $q_1,q_2$ at time $\bar\tau $, \[ \ell (q_1,\bar\tau )+\ell (q_2,\bar\tau )+1\ge \frac{c(n)}{\bar\tau }d_{g(\bar\tau )}(q_1,q_2)^2, \qquad c(n)=\frac1{216(n+2)^2}. \]
